notes: This is a candidate inventory for auditing an existing 3D anatomy model; it does not assert that every listed feature is absent.
First inspect the current project and mark each item Present / Partial / Missing / Needs expert verification.

Each row is an individually auditable anatomical detail requirement, not necessarily one separate 3D mesh. Use separate meshes where independent selection, hiding, animation or isolation is educationally useful.
MBBS core coverage is prioritised, with MD Anatomy-level expansion including histology, embryology, neuroanatomy, cross-sectional/radiological anatomy and clinical correlations.
Use current FIPAT terminology (TA2, TE2, TNA; TH revision status should be checked) and current NMC curriculum documents for syllabus alignment.
Some axes such as blood supply or imaging appearance must be adapted to the specific structure; confirm each item with anatomy faculty or reliable reference before implementation.
Recommended status values: Present; Partial; Missing; Needs verification; Not applicable.
